newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony Music shares fall due to downgrading.
newsitem.headline: Sony Music shares fall due to downgrading.

text.p: Shares in Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc, the Sony group's audio-visual software firm, dropped on Tuesday morning, depressed by Nomura Research Institute's downgrading of the firm, traders said.
The share price of the firm had lost 90 yen to 4,390 yen by 0144 GMT.
Nomura Research Institute Ltd earlier downgraded Sony Music Entertainment to a "2" rating from its previous "1".
"The shares had climbed for three days, and small-lot sales are pulling them down," said a trader at a medium-sized Japanese securities house.

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "2" rating to issues whose values it sees moving within 10 percentage points in either direction of the key 225-share Nikkei average over the next six months.
